ai.title: Trump heads to Asia with hopes of shifting the momentum after midterm setbacks hurt him at home
ai.description: President Donald Trump heads to Asia this week and he's aiming to shift the momentum after Republican losses in the midterm elections. Trump plans a historic meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin to discuss nuclear stockpiles. He's first visiting the Philippines on Tuesday to meet Southeast Asian leaders. Then it's on to China for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit. The trip comes as Democrats prepare to take control of Congress in January and they may try to curb his foreign policy tools. Trump faces scrutiny over issues such as artificial intelligence and trade. The wars in Iran and Ukraine also loom over the trip.
